metadata.description: Fable protocols for Claude Code and an Astra advisor through Codex CLI. Native Astra orchestration for Codex is also included in the repository.

plugins.name: fable-advisor
plugins.description: Consult Claude Fable 5 as a strategic advisor at costly-to-revert inflection points: architecture decisions, stuck debugging, plan review, pre-completion review, and unattended loop/schedule design. Compact briefing packets, hard budget caps, terse verdicts — judgment from Fable, tokens from Opus.

plugins.name: fable-orchestrator
plugins.description: Run Fable 5 as a coordinator: plan big, execute small. Bulk reading — codebase sweeps, log triage, document review, web research, coverage verification — fans out to parallel workers pinned to Sonnet/Haiku, and only distilled findings enter Fable's premium context. Ported to Claude Code from Anthropic's plan-big-execute-small cookbook.

plugins.name: astra-advisor
plugins.description: Consult GPT-6 Astra at consequential decision points with evidence, compact briefs, and bounded interactions. Uses native sub-agents in Codex and Codex CLI in Claude Code.
